title.en: Deterministic seeded random stream
title.yue: 有種子嘅確定性隨機數列

summary.en: One mulberry32 stream per match; every draw in the simulation pulls from it in a fixed order.
summary.yue: 每場對戰得一條 mulberry32 隨機數列，全部隨機都跟固定次序由呢度攞。

title.en: Fixed-point positions and distances
title.yue: 定點數座標同距離

summary.en: Integers in 1/1024 map-unit steps, so a long match cannot drift from float rounding error.
summary.yue: 座標用 1/1024 單位嘅整數，長時間對戰都唔會因為浮點誤差走樣。

title.en: Fixed 30 Hz tick and command queue
title.yue: 固定 30 Hz tick 同指令隊列

summary.en: Simulation state advances in fixed steps, with player actions applied at tick boundaries.
summary.yue: 模擬狀態按固定步進，玩家操作喺 tick 交界先套用。

title.en: Snapshot, restore and state hashing
title.yue: 存檔、還原同狀態雜湊

summary.en: A match's whole state serialises to one snapshot and back, with a stable hash to compare two runs.
summary.yue: 整個對戰狀態可以存做一個 snapshot 再還原，仲有穩定雜湊值比較兩次結果。

title.en: Replay from seed and command log
title.yue: 由種子同指令紀錄重播

summary.en: A match replays byte-for-byte from its seed and recorded commands, proven by matching hash sequences.
summary.yue: 一場對戰可以由種子同紀錄低嘅指令一字不漏重播，用雜湊序列做證明。

title.en: Validated data row shapes with required provenance
title.yue: 有驗證嘅資料行形狀，出處一定要寫

summary.en: Towers, enemies, maps, waves, difficulties and statuses are typed rows; every top-level row cites its wiki source.
summary.yue: 塔、怪、地圖、波次、難度同狀態全部係有型嘅資料行，每行都要註明個 wiki 出處。

title.en: Referential integrity and geometry validator
title.yue: 參照完整性同幾何驗證器

summary.en: Loads every JSON row and rejects a dangling reference or an invalid placement polygon before the game starts.
summary.yue: 載入所有 JSON 資料，一有斷咗嘅參照或者唔啱嘅擺放形狀就即刻拒收。

title.en: Six open statistical questions, tracked rather than guessed
title.yue: 六條未有定論嘅數值，記低嚟唔會靠估

summary.en: Targeting modes beyond the five, mitigation, mark-and-consume, area falloff, Hardcore's real effect and sell refund percent.
summary.yue: 五種以外嘅索敵模式、減免機制、標記同消耗配合、範圍傷害會唔會遞減、Hardcore 實際改啲乜，同賣出退款百分比。

title.en: First tranche of cited towers
title.yue: 第一批有出處嘅塔

summary.en: Real towers as JSON rows, each level's cost, damage and range cited to the wiki it was read from.
summary.yue: 真正嘅塔用 JSON 資料表示，每級嘅價錢、傷害同射程都寫明抄自邊個 wiki。

title.en: Cited enemies, including bosses
title.yue: 有出處嘅怪物，包括 Boss

summary.en: HP, speed, defense, immunities and abilities for the first tranche of enemies and bosses.
summary.yue: 第一批怪物同 Boss 嘅血量、速度、防禦、免疫同技能。

title.en: Two maps with real lanes and placement zones
title.yue: 兩個有真正路線同擺放區嘅地圖

summary.en: Lane waypoints and placement polygons authored as data, ready for the validator to check.
summary.yue: 路線航點同擺放多邊形都寫成資料，等驗證器去查。

title.en: Every difficulty as its own row
title.yue: 每個難度都係獨立一行資料

summary.en: Easy through Hardcore, each with its own cash, HP and speed multipliers and disallowed towers.
summary.yue: 由 Easy 到 Hardcore，各自有金錢、血量同速度倍率，同埋唔准用嘅塔。

title.en: Wave tables per map and difficulty
title.yue: 每個地圖同難度嘅波次表

summary.en: Enemy groups, spawn intervals and completion bonuses, keyed by map and difficulty.
summary.yue: 怪物分組、出怪間隔同完成獎勵，跟地圖同難度分類。

title.en: Targeting: first, last, closest, strongest, weakest
title.yue: 索敵：最先、最後、最近、最強、最弱

summary.en: Five targeting modes with deterministic tie-breaking, so two identical matches pick the same target.
summary.yue: 五種索敵模式，撞形嘅時候都有固定判法，一樣嘅對戰揀返一樣嘅目標。

title.en: Tower abilities and aura recomputation
title.yue: 塔嘅技能同光環重新計算

summary.en: Cooldown-gated abilities, and auras that recompute nearby towers' effective stats fresh every tick.
summary.yue: 有冷卻時間嘅技能，光環每個 tick 都重新計返附近塔嘅實際數值。

title.en: Fire rate, spin-up, burst, reload, hitscan and projectile
title.yue: 射速、加速、連發、裝彈、瞬中同拋射體

summary.en: Every firing pattern a tower level can declare, from a steady hitscan to a bursting, reloading launcher.
summary.yue: 塔嘅每種射擊方式，由穩定瞬中到連發完要裝彈嘅發射器都有。

title.en: Area damage, pierce and chain
title.yue: 範圍傷害、貫穿同連鎖

summary.en: A shot can splash an area, pierce through several enemies, or chain to nearby targets.
summary.yue: 一發可以炸範圍、貫穿幾隻怪，或者連鎖跳去附近目標。

title.en: Damage order: shield, then flat reduction, then hit points
title.yue: 傷害順序：先護盾、再扣減、先至係血量

summary.en: A fixed resolution order for every hit, so shielded and armoured enemies behave the same way every time.
summary.yue: 每次攻擊都跟一個固定順序計算，護盾同裝甲嘅怪物次次表現都一樣。

title.en: Tag-based synergy bonuses
title.yue: 以標籤為本嘅配合加成

summary.en: A generic tag plus a damage multiplier, so a new combo is a data row, not a hardcoded tower pair.
summary.yue: 通用標籤加傷害倍率，新配合只需要加一行資料，唔使寫死邊兩隻塔夾。

title.en: Status effects: stacking, immunities and expiry
title.yue: 狀態效果：疊加、免疫同過期

summary.en: Stun, slow, damage-over-time, debuff and buff, each with its own stacking rule and immunity list.
summary.yue: 暈眩、減速、持續傷害、減益同增益，各自有自己嘅疊加規則同免疫名單。

title.en: Hidden versus detection, flying versus anti-air
title.yue: 隱形對偵測、飛行對防空

summary.en: A hidden enemy needs a detecting tower; a flying enemy needs a tower that hits air, independently of each other.
summary.yue: 隱形怪要靠有偵測能力嘅塔先見到，飛行怪就要防空塔先打得中，兩者互不相干。

title.en: Enemy and boss abilities, including health thresholds
title.yue: 怪物同 Boss 技能，包括血量門檻觸發

summary.en: Summon, stun, shield-phase, heal and speed-phase, some firing once a boss drops below a hit-point fraction.
summary.yue: 召喚、暈眩、護盾階段、治療同加速階段，有啲要 Boss 血量跌到某個比例先觸發。

title.en: Lane pathing with deterministic per-enemy offset
title.yue: 路線行走，每隻怪都有確定性偏移

summary.en: Enemies follow lane waypoints at their own speed, with a small deterministic offset so a group is not a single file.
summary.yue: 怪物跟住路線航點走，速度各自唔同，仲有細細嘅確定性偏移唔會逐隻排晒直線。

title.en: Terrain, footprint collision and shared caps
title.yue: 地形、佔位碰撞同共用上限

summary.en: A tower can only stand on its allowed terrain, cannot overlap another footprint, and some towers share a placement cap.
summary.yue: 塔淨係可以擺喺容許嘅地形，唔可以同其他塔重疊，有啲塔仲要共用擺放上限。

title.en: Wave director: intermission, groups and boss waves
title.yue: 波次導演：中場、分組同 Boss 波

summary.en: Each wave is a set of timed enemy groups with an intermission before it and a completion bonus after it.
summary.yue: 每個波次都係一堆計時嘅怪物分組，波前有中場、波後有完成獎勵。

title.en: Starting cash, kill reward and income towers
title.yue: 起始金錢、擊殺獎勵同收入塔

summary.en: Cash flows in from a starting amount, per-kill rewards, wave completion bonuses and dedicated income towers.
summary.yue: 金錢嘅來源有起始金額、逐隻擊殺獎勵、波次完成獎勵，同埋專門負責搵錢嘅塔。

title.en: Per-difficulty multipliers and disallowed towers
title.yue: 每個難度嘅倍率同禁用塔

summary.en: Cash, enemy HP and enemy speed each scale per difficulty, and some difficulties disallow specific towers.
summary.yue: 金錢、怪物血量同速度會跟難度縮放，有啲難度仲會禁用指定嘅塔。

title.en: Win and loss conditions
title.yue: 勝利同落敗條件

summary.en: Clear every wave to win; run out of lives to lose, with lives sourced from the map or a difficulty override.
summary.yue: 打完晒啲波次就贏，命數清零就輸，命數嚟自地圖或者難度覆寫。

title.en: Canvas renderer decoupled from the simulation rate
title.yue: 同模擬速率分開嘅 Canvas 渲染器

summary.en: Interpolated rendering at display refresh rate, independent of the fixed 30 Hz simulation tick.
summary.yue: 渲染跟住螢幕更新率內插,同固定 30 Hz 嘅模擬 tick 完全分開。

title.en: Material Design 3 shop, tower panel and heads-up display
title.yue: Material Design 3 商店、塔面板同 HUD

summary.en: Every in-game state real: wave start, clear, victory, defeat, pause and settings, built with genuine M3 components.
summary.yue: 遊戲入面每個狀態都係真嘅：開波、通關、勝利、落敗、暫停同設定，全部用真正嘅 M3 元件整。

title.en: Verified at 100, 125, 150 and 200 percent display scale
title.yue: 喺 100、125、150 同 200% 顯示縮放都驗證過

summary.en: The game window is checked at every common Windows display scale with no clipped or overlapping content.
summary.yue: 遊戲視窗喺 Windows 常見嘅每個顯示縮放度都測試過，冇畫面被切或者重疊。

title.en: Unsigned Squirrel.Windows installer
title.yue: 未簽署嘅 Squirrel.Windows 安裝檔

summary.en: A real Squirrel package: Setup.exe, a RELEASES file and delta packages, disclosed as unsigned.
summary.yue: 真正嘅 Squirrel 安裝包：Setup.exe、RELEASES 檔同差異更新包，明確講明未經簽署。

title.en: Chrome-style automatic updates
title.yue: Chrome 風格嘅自動更新

summary.en: Checks for updates in the background and shows a non-blocking ready-to-restart banner, never a forced restart.
summary.yue: 喺背景check更新，得咗會出一個唔阻住你嘅「可以重啟」提示，唔會強制幫你重啟。

title.en: Uniquely tagged, non-draft release on every push
title.yue: 每次 push 都出一個獨立標籤、非草稿嘅 release

summary.en: A workflow that builds, packages and publishes a real installable release with no test or lint gate.
summary.yue: 工作流程會build、打包同發佈一個真正裝得嘅 release，唔會俾測試或者 lint 卡住。

title.en: This Material Design 3 landing and documentation site
title.yue: 呢個 Material Design 3 嘅著陸同文件網站

summary.en: Every bundled asset is local: no content delivery network, no analytics, no third-party tracking.
summary.yue: 所有資源都係本機嘅：冇用 CDN、冇分析工具、冇第三方追蹤。

title.en: One documentation article per feature
title.yue: 每個功能一篇文件

summary.en: Behaviour, configuration, failure modes, security considerations and how to verify it, per feature area.
summary.yue: 每個功能都有行為、設定、可能出錯情況、安全考慮同驗證方法。

title.en: Offline in-app documentation browser
title.yue: 離線嘅內置文件瀏覽器

summary.en: Every article loads from a local bundle checked for completeness at build time, with no network request.
summary.yue: 每篇文件由本機打包載入，build 嗰陣已經check完齊唔齊全，唔使上網。

title.en: Server-rendered social embed metadata
title.yue: 喺伺服器端渲染嘅社交分享圖

summary.en: A real og:image plus dimensions, alt text and a Twitter large-image card baked into the served HTML.
summary.yue: 真正嘅 og:image 連尺寸、alt 文字同 Twitter 大圖卡都寫死喺伺服嘅 HTML 入面。

title.en: English, Cantonese and bilingual language modes
title.yue: 英文、廣東話同雙語模式

summary.en: A language switcher that covers the whole site's chrome, feature summaries and settings, not just a banner.
summary.yue: 語言切換掣覆蓋成個網站嘅介面、功能簡介同設定，唔止得個標語轉。

title.en: Search with a regular-expression builder on every panel
title.yue: 每個面板都有帶正則表達式建構器嘅搜尋

summary.en: A plain-text filter by default, with a regex mode and a live tester popover anchored beside the field.
summary.yue: 預設係純文字篩選，仲有正則模式同一個貼住輸入框嘅即時測試彈窗。

title.en: Dockable tabs with overflow, reorder, pin and groups
title.yue: 可停泊嘅分頁，有溢出選單、排序、釘住同分組

summary.en: Every tab stays reachable through an always-available menu, and layout choices persist across reloads.
summary.yue: 所有分頁都可以透過一個常駐選單搵返，版面設定重新整理都會記得。

title.en: Theme, density, full-spectrum accent and CJK-safe font
title.yue: 主題、疏密、全光譜主色同 CJK 安全字體

summary.en: Light, dark or system theme, three density levels, an HSL accent picker and a font choice with a CJK fallback.
summary.yue: 淺色、深色或跟系統、三種疏密、HSL 主色選擇器，仲有帶 CJK 後備嘅字體選項。
